tests_notes: Largest first, zero and negative k, k beyond the list, duplicates, empty input; workload: a 100000-score leaderboard, top 10.

A.strategy: heapq.nlargest instead of a full sort
A.rationale: Only k values are needed, so a bounded heap does O(n log k) work instead of sorting all n scores. The k <= 0 guard is kept and the result is the same descending list.

B.rationale: Sorting a copy avoids writing back into the caller's list, and slicing the first k gives the same descending result for every k.

C.strategy: Ascending sort with a reversed slice
C.rationale: Conservative micro-optimization: the default ascending sort skips the reverse flag, and a negative-step slice reads the top k from the end of the list.

A.diagnosis: The differential check shows the caller's scores list is no longer sorted afterwards; the original sorts it in place, highest first, and callers rely on that.
A.rationale: Sorts the caller's list in place, highest first, as the original does, and clamps k at zero in the slice so a single code path serves every k.

B.diagnosis: Sorting a copy left the caller's list unsorted. The in-place descending sort is the function's contract, and list.sort is already the fastest way to provide it.
B.rationale: No faster version keeps the contract: every score must end up sorted in the caller's list, and list.sort in C is the cheapest way to do that.

C.diagnosis: The scores list was left in ascending order; the original leaves it sorted highest first. Reverse it after sorting so the caller sees the same order.
C.strategy: Ascending sort, then reverse in place
C.rationale: Sorts ascending, reverses the list in place so it ends highest first like the original, and returns the first k, or nothing when k is zero or less.

notes: The all-rejected story. The tests check return values only, so every candidate passes them; the differential check catches the side effect. A's repair and C's repair sort the list even when k <= 0, which the original never does. B's repair concedes and returns the original, which the static check rejects as identical.
